hard_rules.rule: Regulated gates (AML/blacklist, SLIK, DSR, verification, chassis/BAST) = FAIL-CLOSED; dependency gagal/throw = BLOCK
No-self-approval enforced dua lapis (Flowable task + Java service guard, 403 SELF_APPROVAL_BLOCKED)
Super-user DIHAPUS; no role/grant/bypass setara; audit override historis survive migrasi
Branch pick re-verify server-side terhadap authorized-branch list
Cross-module via event/outbox atau API publik; NO direct repo/tabel access; NO cross-module JOIN write path; ref via credit_id
PO minting owned 04 (exactly one per approval, trigger MemoApproved); JANGAN mint dari credit-analyst
credit_id = business key LOCKED format branch(5)+YY+MM+SEQ(5); mint-once idempotent; generator tunggal
trans_type_id = external-FK LOCKED char-for-char; composition owned ONLY 02; ladder AA00000001 distinct
NPP activation STEP 15 atomik (agreement+PK+jurnal+AR Card+master loan+upsert customer+outbox in one tx; error=ROLLBACK)
po_number assigned non-NULL at mint (fix GOTCHA-6); exactly one PO per approval
log_approval_history append-only audit otoritatif regulatori, independent dari Flowable ACT_*
No cross-DB/cross-company linked-server DML; integrasi via ACL app-tier (ADR-05)
Zero stored procedure; logic 100% application layer (ADR-02)
Schema WAJIB DB-CONVENTIONS (prefix kelas, singular, PK id identity + business key, declared FK, audit cols, satu status)
